text_block_list.text:
Кинг Хало laughs triumphantly in the
winner's
circle after her victory in the
Japanese Derby
before cutting her
moment in the limelight short
and
running off.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
It seems she wanted to distract the
reporters from
Спешл Уик, who left
crying because of her loss.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
After the race, Кинг Хало receives a call
from her
mother, who chastises her
behavior and praises
Спешл Уик's
efforts.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Since her mother is still unwilling to
recognize her
skill, Кинг Хало vows to
win the final race of the
Triple Crown,
the Kikuka Sho.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
